verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's Session Replay docs say replays let you follow up on why customers drop off, and replay playlists can be built from events or properties. That implies a path from funnel drop-off to the affected users' replays, but the evidence never documents a direct one-click jump from a funnel step or an error event. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the funnel-step-to-replay drill-down workflow, any evidence of jumping from error events to replays, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can jump from a funnel drop-off or an error event straight to session replays of the affected users

citations.quote: Now, with Mixpanel Session Replay, you can quickly follow up by exploring why customers drop off.
Save playlists of replays based on events or properties
